select prd.BOOKSET_ID id, nvl(prd.BOOKSET_NAME,prd.BOOKSET_FULLNAME) text from bok_bookset prd where 1=1
AND prd.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE in
#{acctSubjectType}

order by prd.BOOKSET_ID
mapper.insert: insert into BOK_FILE_TRANSFER (SEQ_NO,FINPROD_ID, VAL_DATE, VAL_BAL_FLAG, FINPROD_NAME, FILE_NAME, FILE_PATH, UPLOAD_DATE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{seqNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{valDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{valBalFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{finprodName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{filePath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{uploadDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: select bft.SEQ_NO seqNo, bft.FINPROD_ID finprodId, bft.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, bft.VAL_DATE valDate, bft.VAL_BAL_FLAG valBalFlag, bft.FILE_NAME fileName, bft.FILE_PATH filePath, bft.UPLOAD_DATE uploadDate from BOK_FILE_TRANSFER bft where bft.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and bft.VAL_BAL_FLAG = #{valBalFlag} and bft.VAL_DATE = #{valDate} order by bft.UPLOAD_DATE desc

select bft.SEQ_NO seqNo, bft.FINPROD_ID finprodId, bft.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, bft.VAL_DATE valDate, bft.VAL_BAL_FLAG valBalFlag, bft.FILE_NAME fileName, bft.FILE_PATH filePath, bft.UPLOAD_DATE uploadDate from BOK_FILE_TRANSFER bft where bft.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo}
mapper.insert: insert into BOK_FILE_INFO (FILE_ID,FILE_TYPE, FILE_NAME, FILE_PATH, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{fileId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{fileType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{filePath,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})

insert into BOK_VALBAL_TABLE_FILE (FINPROD_ID, VAL_DATE, VAL_BAL_FLAG, FILE_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME) values (#{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{valDate,jdbcType=DATE}, #{valBalFlag,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.delete: delete from BOK_FILE_INFO bfi where bfi.FILE_ID = #{fileId}
delete from BOK_VALBAL_TABLE_FILE bncf where bncf.FILE_ID = #{fileId}
mapper.select: select bncf.file_id fileId, bncf.FINPROD_ID finprodId, bncf.VAL_DATE valDate, bncf.VAL_BAL_FLAG valBalFlag, bfi.FILE_NAME fileName, bfi.FILE_PATH filePath, bfi.create_time uploadDate from BOK_VALBAL_TABLE_FILE bncf left join BOK_FILE_INFO bfi on bncf.file_id = bfi.file_id where bncf.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and bncf.VAL_BAL_FLAG = #{valBalFlag} and bncf.VAL_DATE = #{valDate} order by bfi.create_time desc

select bncf.file_id fileId, bncf.FINPROD_ID finprodId, bncf.VAL_DATE valDate, bncf.VAL_BAL_FLAG valBalFlag, bfi.FILE_NAME fileName, bfi.FILE_PATH filePath, bfi.create_time uploadDate from BOK_VALBAL_TABLE_FILE bncf left join BOK_FILE_INFO bfi on bncf.file_id = bfi.file_id where bncf.file_id = #{fileId}
